svg.title: StudySpot app: screen flow (UML state machine of the navigation)

g.text: StudySpot app: screen flow (UML state machine of the navigation)
tablet / laptop: navigation rail (labels from 1200 px).
Each tab keeps its own history and scroll position.
Pages keep a readable width on wide screens.
Signed out -> /signin?from=<screen>, then back to it.
Session expired (SEC-009): any screen -> Sign in again.
Allow, or type an area / Skip
tap a place or a pin
a protected tab while signed out
signed in: back to that tab
